note: Both sets capture the same core content of Figure 2-6: the six laminate materials (Glass Biax, Glass Triax, Carbon UD, Glass Uni, Medium Density Foam, Gelcoat) and the CG/GC/NA/SC reference-point coordinates at the 70% span section. Set A adds six 'material layer' claims that merely repeat its 'material' claims under a second attribute name, and it states the GC x3 coordinate twice with conflicting values (0.05 m and 0.0 m), so at least one of those is wrong. Set B is a clean subset with no duplicates or internal contradictions, and it loses nothing essential except the redundant restatement of the 70% span location (already carried in the conditions).
remarks: The reference-point coordinates (CG x2 = -0.15, NA x2 = -0.1, SC x2 = -0.2, and the x3 values near 0.0/0.05) are only readable approximately from the plotted markers on a reversed x2 axis; both sets report them as exact values and I could not verify the digits precisely. Set A's pair of conflicting GC x3 values (0.05 m vs 0.0 m) suggests the extractor emitted both a marker-read value and an axis-line approximation. Note the two condition phrasings ('Section : 0.7' and 'cross section at 70% span') denote the same figure and are effectively duplicates across both sets.
